title: Jeanette NDE 449
content: I was 'partying' with a friend of mine when I was seventeen. We were at the beach. I inhaled this type of gas (that has the potential I found out later of freezing your lungs instantly). I just went black. I don't even remember going out. The next think I remember is 'standing' in the middle of a vortex tunnel with a person in silhouette standing at the end of the tunnel. I would say the tunnel was approximately thirty yards. I could not see the face but he/she wore a garment that was very loose and flowing to his/her right. The tunnel was interesting because it was swirling with all pastel colors. The person at the end had their arms stretched out to me. I remember not really feeling scared, but more confused as to where I was. The last thing I remember doing is looking down to see that I was 'levitating' in this standing position, but that the tunnel was circling under my feet about ten feet down. The circumference of the tunnel I would estimate to be about (it's hard to remember) twenty feet. It was really beautiful. No words were spoken. No movement of air. No sensation of any temperature at all (neither warm nor cold). That was it. I came back and I was fine -- although a little shaken to say the least.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accidental overdose Life threatening event, but not clinical death Inhaling CO2 cartridges.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Boundary | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain Parts of my body did not seem to be there. I'm not really sure if my feet were there.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning There did not seem to be a sense of time.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: No sound at all. Although there appeared to be a wind swirling the colors in the tunnel and the person's garments, I heard no wind sound either.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes Did not pass through a tunnel, remained at the beginning of it.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes A person in silhouette. Could not make out any features. Wore loose garments. Especially around wrist area the garment was longer.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm The tunnel was beautiful. I seemed to be there only a short time.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you reach a boundary or limiting phy: Yes This tunnel was a boundary. I imagine if I would have gone ahead I would have met the person at the end.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I believe we go 'somewhere' after death.
elements.After the NDE: included: Presence of unearthly beings After the NDE
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The experience. Knowing that there could definitely be a place we go after death of our bodies.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes But limited. I feel people think that I am elaborating or not telling the truth. I don't tell many people unless they have had a similar experience.
